route.name: Schoorl - Julianadorp- Den Helder 42 km ENG 2025

course_points.n: Turn right onto Strandslag Sint Maartenszee
Turn right onto Duinweg to Junction 12
Turn right onto Het Nieuwe Diep

points_of_interest.name: Oud Schoorlse Zeedijk
points_of_interest.description: Since the 14th Century, this was the dike against the tidal sea. From about 1880 they started to make land out of sea (polder).

points_of_interest.name: Hondsbossche Zeewering
points_of_interest.description: Big dike against the sea (covered with sandy dunes). Take a view on the beach.
